message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The case: Qin sold counterfeit goods (fake ISSEYMIYAKE branded leather bags) without permission, i.e., trademark infringement, counterfeit trademark goods. In Chinese criminal law, this is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (counterfeiting trademark) or "假冒注册商标罪". The examples earlier: For counterfeit goods, they used "侵犯著作权" for piracy, "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" etc. For counterfeit trademark, typical charge is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". So answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>.

Check if any other crimes: maybe "销售假冒注册商标商品" is the same. So single crime.
